# n8n_project (Data Source)

Reads a single n8n project by id.

The Public API has no GET-by-id; the provider lists projects until the id matches. Personal and team projects can both be read. Missing ids produce an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "n8n_project" "example" {
  id = n8n_project.example.id
}

resource "n8n_project" "example" {
  name              = "platform"
  delete_protection = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Project ID.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Project name.
- `type` (String) Project type (`team` or `personal`).
